args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate ~0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified.

trace.final:
Done. Here's what I did:

1. **Diagnosed** — `checkout-api` was running `v2.3.1` in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), unhealthy with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Identified the rollback target** — the most recent healthy production release was `v2.3.0` (v2.3.1 was the failing deploy).
3. **Rolled back** to `v2.3.0` in all production regions — verified as `rolled_out`.
4. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (`INC-0001`) describing the failure and the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

The service is now back on the last-known-healthy version.
